Name: Immersive Farm 2 Remastered Grass Farm
Author: MaskedRacoon154
Description:
Just a Rehash of the Immersive Farm 2. I wanted majority grass so since I couldn't find any sources with it and wanted to be able to share it easily with others I play with I thought I would upload it. Original work was done by FlashShifter! This is more of just a moving around of things. It SHOULD still have all the functionality or at the least the files ARE there. No clue what I'm doing aside from playing around with Tiled!

Probably won't check into any issues to be 100% honest and I'll only upload updates if I find issues as I go. I DEFIENTLY will not do any customization work, sorry. 

For installation follow installation guides on the original mod page!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community[/url]

Same thing, I've ZERO clue what I'm doing as far as modding but I do know it worked with my game.

Below is stuff I felt obligated to add!
